items.title: Thanks, I’m Just Looking
items.summary: The New York art fairs, the worst of the Venice Biennale, Taryn Simon’s incomplete detective story, and Damien Hirst’s gay hole.

items.title: No One Is Reading, Except at the New York Art Book Fair
items.summary: The overlooked, subversive, and playful currents of politics and queer culture flow freely at the fair’s 20th anniversary edition, held at MoMA PS1.

items.title: Here’s What (Dealers Said) Sold at the Armory Show
items.summary: If collectors had any concerns about the wars or inflation, they did not seem to share them at the New York fair, where the mood was almost too serene.
